chapter.num: A Long Day in the Mountains: Chapter 1
chapter.title: Paradise

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: Venipi! You're still alive! How wonderful to see you!

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: Of course I know that death is not possible here. What I mean is, I'm so glad you didn't turn into sand.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: Anyway, you know what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: And thanks to all of you, and Dex too.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Venipi introduces you all to Vitruvius and recounts what just happened...

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: Incredible — your strength exceeds even that of a typical Chief Centurion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, even Paimon's kinda interested to see how you actually stack up in that system.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: In that case, I'll take you to the others.

dialogues.speaker: Vitruvius
dialogues.text: After all, Venipi only provided the pattern work and motifs from King Deshret's times. I was the one responsible for the main layout and pathways in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Venipi
dialogues.text: That's right. While this may look like a building from some gilded age, it's really the result of everyone's knowledge.
